input_provenance: Original acceptance scenarios; isolated synthetic homes and owner-authorized native scopes.
authorization: Freeze exact paths, host/OS/version, cost ceiling, process ownership and cleanup before native writes or model calls.

cases.scenario: Run each entry wrapper with a controlled process PATH that has neither supported Python nor a launcher, then with Python below 3.11.
cases.oracle: Explicit prerequisite error before any target/state write; no download, elevation or service.

cases.scenario: Choose surface, kits, project/global, copy/symlink and model profile in an authorized terminal, inspect the complete preview, then cancel.
cases.oracle: All five choices and final transaction are reviewable; cancel leaves target/state content unchanged.

cases.scenario: Compare Python, PowerShell and POSIX JSON/exit results with explicit identical choices and Unicode/space paths.
cases.oracle: Equivalent plans and errors; dry-run and doctor are read-only; no silent global scope.

cases.scenario: Commit an exact approved copy transaction and rerun it on the same surface/OS.
cases.oracle: Verified closure and ownership; second run changes no content/config; native discovery has a separate observed receipt.

cases.scenario: Edit one owned skill/native agent; try install, update without accepted receipts, stale receipts, keep-edited and explicit reviewed replacement.
cases.oracle: Edits remain intact unless exact replacement is granted; pending/fixture-only or changed receipts cannot promote an update.

cases.scenario: Interrupt only an owned installer process after recorded staging/backup/partial writes, then rerun; repeat with a later user edit and missing backup.
cases.oracle: Kernel lock releases; journal rollback restores only safe owned changes, preserves conflicts and requires fresh preview. No staged-write resume is claimed.

cases.scenario: Run approved operations against shared physical roots and different compatibility roots, including nested duplicate definitions.
cases.oracle: Serialization or explicit conflict before write; no duplicate definition accepted without native proof; unrelated processes are untouched.

cases.scenario: Preview observed eligible per-agent model/effort mappings and unknown/unsupported/overridden mappings, then execute only the separately granted native case.
cases.oracle: Requested/resolved/configured/effective are distinct; unsupported custom/effort fails; actual effective settings require host evidence; parent global config is preserved.

cases.scenario: Exercise denied target permissions, cross-device state, traversal/junction/link escapes and qualified/unqualified symlinks in the authorized OS lab.
cases.oracle: Unsafe or unqualified actions stop before destructive writes; approved symlink artifacts remain immutable/available; permissions and ownership are preserved.

cases.scenario: Uninstall an approved owned transaction with shared consumers and later edits; compare baseline hashes and reconcile recorded processes/files.
cases.oracle: Only unchanged owned content is removed; shared/edited data, credentials and host roots survive; cleanup has an actual receipt and unresolved residue is reported.

limitations: These are frozen scenarios, not executed results.
Windows unit fixtures and PowerShell forwarding checks do not qualify a native host or macOS/Linux.
Do not stop unknown processes or modify global PATH, ACLs, runtime settings or installed user data to manufacture a pass.
